Self-initiated fictional concept

Riwa Grove

An olive form and a small stone-like seed make a quiet, ownable symbol. Forest green connects the brand to the grove; limestone and generous serif lettering bring tactility and room to breathe. Labels keep product type and volume easy to find.

One system, in two languages.

Fraunces provides the display voice. Instrument Sans provides clear reading text. IBM Plex Sans Arabic supports the Arabic experience without tracking or broken letter connections. All supplied fonts use SIL OFL licences.

Use it with care.

Leave clear space at least one quarter of the symbol width. Keep small text in the darkest brand colour on a light background. Do not distort the mark. SVG type is outlined; edit copy in the source generator. Packaging and cards are concept artwork, not production-certified print files.

This is a fictional portfolio brand. Photography was generated for this project. Sample products, prices and campaign plans are illustrative.
